title: palateDevelopManuscript: Processing scripts and code for the palate development manuscript (scRNA-seq & ATAC-seq)
description: Processing scripts, plotting code, and step-by-step documentation accompanying the manuscript An ARID3A-dependent epithelial progenitor state supports timely palate morphogenesis. The repository contains the basic scRNA-seq and ATAC-seq processing pipelines and figure-generation scripts.
